name: Momoe Link
source:
Momoe is an active and sweet pink cybergirl who loves to sing. She has many friends, a great career...

But for now, she decided to take a break and visit her friends. There are Jambu, Shade, and... Candy.
But wait! The real reason behind all that is... a love confession from somebody?!?!

[From [url=https://kanatahiba.itch.io/momoe-link]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
百惠是一位活跃、甜美、喜欢唱歌的粉色网络女孩。她有很多朋友，事业也很出色……

但现在，她决定休息一下，去拜访她的朋友们。有Jambu、Shade和……Candy。
但是等等！这一切背后的真正原因是……某人的告白？！？！
